AI Recruiting Engine v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a full-cycle AI-powered recruiting agent with zero external dependencies.
- Provides structured frameworks for role intake, including sample blueprints and intake questions.
- Delivers detailed sourcing strategies, outreach templates, and Boolean search examples.
- Introduces comprehensive resume screening and interview scorecards for evidence-based evaluation.
- Highlights pipeline automation and data-driven decision-making throughout the hiring lifecycle.
